title: Record the five-cell basis gap
body:
## Summary
- On one five-cell query, the VVV floor is 15 and the MMM floor is 18. The coordinate basis attains 15 once. Changing only the four-dimensional basis raises the minimum to 17 and leaves no attaining assignment.
- Both bases still attain the MMM floor 18. The cells are the same query. The selected kappa is unchanged.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The other fixtures are not enumerated.
